dialogues.jp: 翌日、叶はクラスに姿を見せなかった。
dialogues.en: Since that day, Kanae never showed up at school.
dialogues.text: Since that day, Kanae never showed up at school.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「工藤君……大丈夫なのかな」
dialogues.en: "Kudou-kun... do you know if Kudou-kun's alright?"
dialogues.text: "Kudou-kun... do you know if Kudou-kun's alright?"

dialogues.jp:
心配そうな表情を浮かべたことりが俺に｛たず／訊｝ねて
くる。
dialogues.en:
A worried expression on her face, Kotori naturally asked the
person closest to her.
dialogues.text:
A worried expression on her face, Kotori naturally asked the
person closest to her.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりは先生から何か聞いてないか？」
dialogues.en: "You didn't hear anything from sensei?"
dialogues.text: "You didn't hear anything from sensei?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は逆に聞き返した。暦先生なら何か事情を知っ
ているかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
I asked her a question as an answer. Maybe Koyomi-sensei
knows something, somehow.
dialogues.text:
I asked her a question as an answer. Maybe Koyomi-sensei
knows something, somehow.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、ただ休むってだけ……」
dialogues.en: "No, just that she was resting..."
dialogues.text: "No, just that she was resting..."

dialogues.jp: ことりは済まなそうに答えて目をふせる。
dialogues.en: She looked downwards when she finished talking.
dialogues.text: She looked downwards when she finished talking.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "...I see."
dialogues.text: "...I see."

dialogues.jp:
俺は主のいない斜め前の席を眺めながら、ただ
ただ、いたずらに流れていく時間を過ごした。
dialogues.en:
Most of my classes were spent just staring at the empty seat
a few rows in front of me.
dialogues.text:
Most of my classes were spent just staring at the empty seat
a few rows in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 授業の内容なんかさっぱり頭に入らなかった。
dialogues.en:
Everything that was being taught couldn't enter my already
overflowing brain.
dialogues.text:
Everything that was being taught couldn't enter my already
overflowing brain.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「さようなら………………朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Farewell... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Farewell... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って笑った叶、その言葉の真意が知りた
かった。
dialogues.en:
When she said that while smiling... I want to know what she
really meant by that.
dialogues.text:
When she said that while smiling... I want to know what she
really meant by that.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ」
dialogues.en: "Damnit..."
dialogues.text: "Damnit..."

dialogues.jp: せめて……声だけでも聴きたい。
dialogues.en: At the very least... I want to hear her voice.
dialogues.text: At the very least... I want to hear her voice.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだ、電話……」
dialogues.en: "That's right, the phone..."
dialogues.text: "That's right, the phone..."

dialogues.jp:
昼休みを待って、事務室から生徒名簿を借りて
きた。
dialogues.en:
I waited till the break, and "borrowed" the student register
from Koyomi-sensei's office.
dialogues.text:
I waited till the break, and "borrowed" the student register
from Koyomi-sensei's office.

dialogues.jp: はやる気持ちを抑えて、携帯のボタンを押す。
dialogues.en: Calming my feelings, I started dialing her number.
dialogues.text: Calming my feelings, I started dialing her number.

dialogues.jp: 「叶……出てくれよ」
dialogues.en: "Kanae... please pick up."
dialogues.text: "Kanae... please pick up."

dialogues.jp: 四回程コール音が鳴り響いて、
dialogues.en: The phone on the other end rang 4 times, until,
dialogues.text: The phone on the other end rang 4 times, until,

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp: 『はい、工藤でございます』
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Kudou residence."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Kudou residence."

dialogues.jp:
電話口に出たのは叶ではなく、老婦人の声だっ
た。
dialogues.en:
The one who answered the phone wasn't Kanae, but an older
woman's voice.
dialogues.text:
The one who answered the phone wasn't Kanae, but an older
woman's voice.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、あの……朝倉と申しますが……叶さんは
　いらっしゃいますでしょうか」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, uhm... this is Asakura speaking... may I speak to
Kanae-san?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, uhm... this is Asakura speaking... may I speak to
Kanae-san?"

dialogues.jp:
一瞬うろたえながらも、「ここでしっかりしな
ければ」と無理に己に｛こぶべんたつ／鼓舞鞭撻｝を加える。
dialogues.en:
As easy as it is to calm yourself beforehand, once something
goes wrong, it's impossible to keep from getting
flustered...
dialogues.text:
As easy as it is to calm yourself beforehand, once something
goes wrong, it's impossible to keep from getting
flustered...

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
『まあまあ、貴方が？　叶さんからつねづねお
　話は聞いていますよ』
dialogues.en: "My my, it's you? Kanae-san is always talking about you."
dialogues.text: "My my, it's you? Kanae-san is always talking about you."

dialogues.jp: 愛想の良い笑い声が響いてくる。
dialogues.en: Her gentle laugh filled my ears.
dialogues.text: Her gentle laugh filled my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
『叶さんがたいへんお世話になっているそうで。
　ありがとうございます』
dialogues.en:
"You have been looking out for her through some very bad
circumstances, haven't you? Thank you very much."
dialogues.text:
"You have been looking out for her through some very bad
circumstances, haven't you? Thank you very much."

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp: 「え？　いえ、そんな……とんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Eh? No, that's... it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Eh? No, that's... it's nothing."

dialogues.jp:
丁寧な応対に、電話越しだというのに思わず頭
を下げてしまう俺。
dialogues.en:
I even bowed my head politely, even though it wouldn't be
conveyed through the phone.
dialogues.text:
I even bowed my head politely, even though it wouldn't be
conveyed through the phone.

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
『あいすみませんが、叶さんは今お電話には出
　られませんの』
dialogues.en:
"In any case, my deepest apologies, but Kanae-san cannot
answer the the phone currently."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, my deepest apologies, but Kanae-san cannot
answer the the phone currently."

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
「！！　………………そんなに調子が良くない
　んですか！？」
dialogues.en: "!! ......... Has her condition deteriorated that much!?"
dialogues.text: "!! ......... Has her condition deteriorated that much!?"

dialogues.jp: 老婦人の声に、思わず声が大きくなる。
dialogues.en: My voice rose several notches unintentionally.
dialogues.text: My voice rose several notches unintentionally.

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
『あら、いいえ。そんなに大したことではあり
　ませんから。いけない子だこと、お友達に心
　配をかけて』
dialogues.en:
"Oh my, not at all. It is not something as big as that. Do
not worry, nothing bad has become of her."
dialogues.text:
"Oh my, not at all. It is not something as big as that. Do
not worry, nothing bad has become of her."

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
「そんな……あの、大したことはないって……
　どんな状態なんですか！？　お願いします、
　教えてください！！」
dialogues.en:
"Then... um, if it's not something big... then may I know
what's going on!? Please, I really want to know!!"
dialogues.text:
"Then... um, if it's not something big... then may I know
what's going on!? Please, I really want to know!!"

dialogues.jp:
しつこく食い下がる俺に老婦人がふと黙り込ん
だ。
dialogues.en:
My stubbornness and insistence led to a bout of silence from
the woman.
dialogues.text:
My stubbornness and insistence led to a bout of silence from
the woman.

dialogues.jp: いけない……変に思われただろうか。
dialogues.en: This is bad... now she'd think I'm weird.
dialogues.text: This is bad... now she'd think I'm weird.

dialogues.jp:
ただの友人が病状を心配してかけてきた電話に
しては、俺の態度は明らかに不自然だ。
dialogues.en:
Normal friends may call due to worriedness about illnesses,
but my behaviour's been far from normal.
dialogues.text:
Normal friends may call due to worriedness about illnesses,
but my behaviour's been far from normal.

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
『朝倉さんはのんびりした方だと伺ったんです
　けれど……意外に情熱的なんですのねえ』
dialogues.en:
"I have heard that you are a rather carefree and leisurely
young man... yet this is unexpectedly passionate."
dialogues.text:
"I have heard that you are a rather carefree and leisurely
young man... yet this is unexpectedly passionate."

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前でしょう！　大切な人の安否が分か
　らない時にまでだらけてたら、ほんとのダメ
　人間ですよ！！」
dialogues.en:
"Of course it is! When I don't know about the well-being of
the people important to me, pepople who don't are the
worst!"
dialogues.text:
"Of course it is! When I don't know about the well-being of
the people important to me, pepople who don't are the
worst!"

dialogues.jp: 言ってしまってからはっとなる。
dialogues.en: I just rambled without thinking.
dialogues.text: I just rambled without thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp: 『あらあらまあ』
dialogues.en: "Oh my, my my."
dialogues.text: "Oh my, my my."

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp: 「い、いやその…………」
dialogues.en: "Ah, um, I..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um, I..."

dialogues.jp: 馬鹿馬鹿俺の馬鹿。
dialogues.en: Stupid, stupid, I'm so stupid.
dialogues.text: Stupid, stupid, I'm so stupid.

dialogues.jp: 額から脂汗がたらたらと流れる。
dialogues.en: My forehead was breaking out in cold sweat.
dialogues.text: My forehead was breaking out in cold sweat.

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp:
『うふふふ、構いませんのよ。こんなに想って
　くださる殿方に出会えて、幸せな子だこと』
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha, it is okay. She really is a blessed child to have
met such a fine gentleman like you, who thinks about her so
much."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha, it is okay. She really is a blessed child to have
met such a fine gentleman like you, who thinks about her so
much."

dialogues.jp:
ころころと笑う声は年齢に似合わずなんだかと
ても可愛らしかった。
dialogues.en:
Her pleasant laugh was well-matched to her age, and even
sounded somewhat cute.
dialogues.text:
Her pleasant laugh was well-matched to her age, and even
sounded somewhat cute.

dialogues.speaker: Old Woman
dialogues.jp: 『貴男のお気持ち、ようく分かりましたわ』
dialogues.en: "I fully understand your feelings now."
dialogues.text: "I fully understand your feelings now."

dialogues.jp: やわらかく、静かな声。
dialogues.en: Her tone changed to a soft, barely audible one.
dialogues.text: Her tone changed to a soft, barely audible one.

dialogues.en: "Ah, wait..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, wait..."

dialogues.jp: かちん、と音を立てて電話の声は途切れた。
dialogues.en: But with a click, I was cut off mid-sentence.
dialogues.text: But with a click, I was cut off mid-sentence.

dialogues.jp:
あとは、ツーツーツーという無機質な音が残る
のみで……。
dialogues.en: All that was left was a meaningless dial tone.
dialogues.text: All that was left was a meaningless dial tone.

dialogues.jp: 完全に墓穴を掘ったような気がする。
dialogues.en: I've completely dug my own grave now.
dialogues.text: I've completely dug my own grave now.

dialogues.jp:
俺はやむなく叶と話すことを諦め、とぼとぼと
教室へ向かった。
dialogues.en:
I reluctantly gave up on talking to Kanae, and stumbled back
to class.
dialogues.text:
I reluctantly gave up on talking to Kanae, and stumbled back
to class.

dialogues.jp:
（そういえば………………電話に出たあの人は
　誰だったんだろう？）
dialogues.en:
"(Come to think of it... who was the person who answered the
phone?)"
dialogues.text:
"(Come to think of it... who was the person who answered the
phone?)"

dialogues.jp: 今更のようにその疑問が頭をかすめた。
dialogues.en: Only now did that question pop into my head.
dialogues.text: Only now did that question pop into my head.

dialogues.jp: ――しかし、それよりも心配なのは叶だ。
dialogues.en: --But, I was far more worried about Kanae than that.
dialogues.text: --But, I was far more worried about Kanae than that.

dialogues.jp: 叶………………何事もなければいいのだが。
dialogues.en: Kanae... whatever happens, I'm fine with, except...
dialogues.text: Kanae... whatever happens, I'm fine with, except...

dialogues.jp: 『さようなら……』
dialogues.en: "Farewell..."
dialogues.text: "Farewell..."

dialogues.jp: 思いつめたような言葉がまた｛のうり／脳裡｝に蘇る。
dialogues.en: Those words once again came back to haunt my mind.
dialogues.text: Those words once again came back to haunt my mind.

dialogues.jp:
大丈夫だ、俺はその言葉を心の中に強く刻み込
んだ。
dialogues.en:
It's fine. I've engraved her words from before deep into my
heart.
dialogues.text:
It's fine. I've engraved her words from before deep into my
heart.

dialogues.jp:
なんでもない。ことりの言うとおり、叶はちょっ
とした風邪をひいただけで……。
dialogues.en:
She's fine. It's probably as Kotori said, she's probably
just resting from a cold...
dialogues.text:
She's fine. It's probably as Kotori said, she's probably
just resting from a cold...

dialogues.jp:
夜になれば、きっといつものように電話が掛かっ
て来る。
dialogues.en: Surely she'd call me tonight, since I called.
dialogues.text: Surely she'd call me tonight, since I called.

dialogues.jp:
そしたら、あんまり心配かけるなよって言って
やるさ。
dialogues.en: Then I'd tell her how worried I was.
dialogues.text: Then I'd tell her how worried I was.

dialogues.jp: 大丈夫。
dialogues.en: It'd be fine.
dialogues.text: It'd be fine.

dialogues.jp: 大丈夫なんだ……。
dialogues.en: It'd definitely be fine...
dialogues.text: It'd definitely be fine...

dialogues.jp:
しかし、その夜、叶から電話がかかってくるこ
とはなかった。
dialogues.en: But that night, the phone didn't ring even once.
dialogues.text: But that night, the phone didn't ring even once.

dialogues.jp:
こちらから電話を掛けようかとも思ったが、そ
れは叶に迷惑がかかるだろう。
dialogues.en:
I considered phoning her instead, but figured that would
only trouble her.
dialogues.text:
I considered phoning her instead, but figured that would
only trouble her.

dialogues.jp: そう思って我慢した。
dialogues.en: I just need more patience.
dialogues.text: I just need more patience.

dialogues.jp:
俺は廊下で毛布に包まりながら、鳴らない電話
をいつまでも待ちつづけた。
dialogues.en:
Wrapped up in a blanket at the corridor near the telephone,
I waited for a call that would not come.
dialogues.text:
Wrapped up in a blanket at the corridor near the telephone,
I waited for a call that would not come.

dialogues.jp: ◆広がる不安◆
dialogues.en: ◆Spreading Anxiety◆
dialogues.text: ◆Spreading Anxiety◆

dialogues.jp: 叶が学校を休んだ。
dialogues.en: Kanae didn't go to school.
dialogues.text: Kanae didn't go to school.

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、いてもたってもいられなくなった俺は、
叶の家に電話をかける。
dialogues.en:
During lunch break, I tried to call her house to talk to
her.
dialogues.text:
During lunch break, I tried to call her house to talk to
her.

dialogues.jp:
電話に出たのは物腰の柔らかそうな老婦人で、
結局叶と話すことはできなかった。
dialogues.en:
A mild-mannered old woman answered the phone, and in the
end, I wasn't able to talk to Kanae.
dialogues.text:
A mild-mannered old woman answered the phone, and in the
end, I wasn't able to talk to Kanae.

dialogues.jp:
大丈夫、きっとことりの言うとおり、ただ風邪
をひいただけなんだ。俺は必死でそう自分に言
い聞かせるのだった
dialogues.en:
It'd be fine, it'd definitely be what Kotori said, that
she's down with a cold. I desperately tried to make myself
believe my own words.
dialogues.text:
It'd be fine, it'd definitely be what Kotori said, that
she's down with a cold. I desperately tried to make myself
believe my own words.
